subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: What default chat-visible policy should OpenClaw use for tool failure reasons and same-turn retry recovery across trusted operator chats and external-recipient channels?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the safe behavior depends on maintainer intent for redaction, channel trust, operator noise, and duplicate-side-effect risk rather than a purely mechanical code fix.

options.title: Adopt safe summaries
options.body: Show redacted or allowlisted failure reasons and a recovered-before-final state when a matching failed action later succeeds, with tests for compact, verbose, and channel-sensitive behavior.

options.title: Keep compact defaults
options.body: Leave compact warnings without reasons by default and rely on verbose mode or suppressToolErrors for operators who prefer a different privacy/noise tradeoff.

options.title: Defer to native recovery
options.body: Treat the visible warning change as dependent on the broader native recovery design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85914.

recommendation.title: Adopt safe summaries
recommendation.body: Show redacted or allowlisted failure reasons and a recovered-before-final state when a matching failed action later succeeds, with tests for compact, verbose, and channel-sensitive behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current warning-detail gate and centralized tool-error visibility policy trace most directly to this owner history, and the unresolved question is a core security/product policy choice.
